categories.main_business_segments: Hefei Jingsong Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in intelligent logistics system solutions and manufacturing, focusing on intelligent warehousing, intelligent handling, intelligent distribution, intelligent factories, and system platforms. The company develops and manufactures intelligent warehousing logistics equipment and software, providing integrated intelligent warehousing logistics systems primarily for manufacturing industries such as automotive, chemical, metallurgy, new energy, machinery, textiles, electronics, and power equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes self-developed core technologies including AGV vehicle control systems, heavy-duty forklift AGV mechanical design and motion control, AGV execution mechanisms, stacker and shuttle car structural design, and sorting control technologies. It integrates advanced technologies such as laser SLAM navigation, visual navigation, multi-sensor fusion, AI, IoT, big data analytics, and cloud computing. Production is order-driven with customized design, manufacturing, installation, and commissioning, supported by proprietary software systems like WMS, WCS, MES, and AGV scheduling systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large enterprises in industries including automotive, chemical, metallurgy, new energy, machinery, textiles, electronics, and power equipment. The company serves manufacturing sectors requiring intelligent warehousing and logistics automation solutions. Major customers include well-known domestic and international companies, with top clients accounting for over 40% of sales. The company also targets emerging sectors such as cold chain logistics, smart factories, and third-party logistics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and production facilities in Hefei and subsidiaries in Hangzhou. It has established AGV business units in multiple Chinese cities including Guangzhou, Chengdu, Shenyang, Hangzhou, Jinan, and Zhengzhou. The company is actively expanding its presence in overseas markets leveraging its domestic project experience and technology.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jingsong Intelligent operates mainly in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and integration of intelligent warehousing logistics equipment and software systems. It provides end-to-end solutions including system planning, equipment manufacturing, software development, system integration, project implementation, and after-sales service, serving as a system integrator and equipment supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in intelligent logistics and warehousing technologies, with significant R&D investment (8.61% of revenue in 2023). Key R&D directions include advanced AGV technologies, heavy-load AGVs, visual and laser navigation, intelligent scheduling algorithms, cloud-based robot monitoring platforms, and autonomous mapping. It focuses on industry-specific solutions for heavy industries like metallurgy, chemical, and new energy, and pursues digital transformation and global market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through sales of intelligent warehousing logistics equipment and integrated intelligent warehousing logistics systems. The company employs a direct sales model with prepayment, delivery payment, acceptance payment, and warranty payment stages. It also provides software and after-sales services, with revenues recognized upon customer acceptance of delivered products and services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jingsong Intelligent is a well-known domestic provider of intelligent warehousing logistics equipment and systems, holding a competitive position in China’s intelligent logistics market. It competes with both domestic and international companies in the intelligent manufacturing and logistics automation sectors. The company’s core technology independence, comprehensive product portfolio, and industry-specific solutions provide competitive advantages. It is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise and a high-tech company.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 664.8 million, a 13.69% increase from 2022, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 42.3 million, a 40.35% decrease year-over-year. Total assets reached RMB 1.53 billion, up 19.24%, and net assets attributable to shareholders were RMB 800.6 million, up 3.77%. The company increased R&D and sales expenses significantly to support growth and innovation. Despite profit decline, the company maintains steady revenue growth and expanding asset base.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jingsong Intelligent emphasizes providing customized, integrated intelligent warehousing logistics solutions combining proprietary hardware and software to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve competitiveness for manufacturing clients. Its self-developed core technologies, including advanced AGV control and navigation systems, heavy-load handling capabilities, and intelligent scheduling algorithms, differentiate its products. The company’s full business chain service from design to after-sales, strong R&D capabilities, and industry-specific expertise create high customer value and foster long-term partnerships.
